blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate Impeachment Court Presiding Officer Francis Escudero said on Tuesday that a defense witness in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial had yet to submit documents requested by the senator-judges. The witness, Davao City Assessor Engr. Jaime Adalin, was asked to provide a list of properties owned by Duterte and her spouse, Atty. Manases Carpio, in Barangay Matina Crossing, Talomo. Adalin was also asked to provide the name of the travel agency that assisted him in flying to China after he confirmed traveling to the country with other Davao City officials. “Yesterday, a request was made by Senator-judge […]...
